lessons.title: Why do trends even exist?
lessons.hook: If everyone can see the news at once, why does price drift for weeks?

lessons.title: Money does not burn — it moves rooms
lessons.hook: Headlines say a trillion dollars was wiped out. Where did it actually go?

lessons.title: The economy breathes in and out
lessons.hook: Why can't the good times just keep going forever?

lessons.title: Markets move before the news arrives
lessons.hook: The recession started in 2008 — so why did stocks top out in 2007?

lessons.title: The Fed only reads two numbers
lessons.hook: The world economy is huge. How can two numbers run the whole thing?

lessons.title: Bonds are the market that bosses the others
lessons.hook: Everyone talks about stocks. So why do professionals watch bonds instead?

lessons.title: When short loans pay more than long ones
lessons.hook: Would you accept less to lend your money for longer? Sometimes the market does.

lessons.title: Why the dollar follows interest rates
lessons.hook: What decides whether the dollar goes up or down against other money?

lessons.title: Why gold hates real yields
lessons.hook: A war just started — so why did gold go DOWN?

lessons.title: Stocks measure how brave people feel
lessons.hook: Why do stocks sometimes rise on bad news about the economy?

lessons.title: The VIX is the price of fear insurance
lessons.hook: Can you actually measure how scared the market is?

lessons.title: The four seasons of money
lessons.hook: Does any of this repeat, or is every year a brand new mess?

lessons.title: Markets move on the bet, not the announcement
lessons.hook: The Fed raised rates exactly as expected — so why did nothing move?

lessons.title: The big players must show their cards
lessons.hook: Is there any way to see what the largest traders are actually doing?
